title: How to cap a percentage at 100%
task: Progress bars and completion metrics that shouldn't read 137%.

excel.note: A2=actual, B2=target; format as %. MIN picks the smaller of the ratio and 100%.

explanation: MIN(1, ratio) lets normal progress through untouched and flattens anything past the target to exactly 100%: 137/100 caps at 1. The mirror MAX(0,...) floors negatives, and both together — MAX(0,MIN(1,A2/B2)) — is the standard progress-bar clamp. Cap the DISPLAY only (keep 137% in the data, show 100% in the bar) by clamping in the chart's helper column, not the source.
